references.text: Describes the beginning of Jesus' public ministry in Galilee after John's imprisonment, parallel to Mark 1:14.
Luke also mentions Jesus' activity in Galilee after John's imprisonment, which aligns with Mark 1:14.
John's imprisonment is mentioned as a time marker for Jesus' activity, similar to Mark 1:14.
The prophecy of a great light in Galilee as a reference to Jesus' ministry there can be seen as a precursor to the events in Mark 1:14.
